title: Order Management
description: Learn how to manage customer orders, update order status, and process shipments in Tijraa.
content:
Order Management

Managing orders efficiently is crucial for your e-commerce business. This guide covers everything you need to know about order management in Tijraa.

Viewing Orders

To view all orders:

  1. Navigate to "Orders" in the sidebar
  2. You'll see a list of all orders with key information
  3. Use filters to find specific orders

Order Statuses

Orders go through several statuses:

  • Pending: Order placed but not confirmed
  • Confirmed: Payment received, order confirmed
  • Processing: Order being prepared
  • Shipped: Order shipped with tracking number
  • Delivered: Order successfully delivered
  • Cancelled: Order cancelled
  • Refunded: Payment refunded to customer

Updating Order Status

To update an order status:

  1. Click on an order to view details
  2. Click "Edit" or the status dropdown
  3. Select the new status
  4. Add notes if needed
  5. Click "Save"

Adding Tracking Information

When shipping an order:

  1. Open the order details
  2. Navigate to the shipping section
  3. Enter the tracking number
  4. Select the shipping carrier
  5. Save the information

The customer will automatically receive a notification with tracking details.

Generating Invoices

To generate an invoice:

  1. Open the order details
  2. Click "Generate Invoice"
  3. The invoice will be created in PDF format
  4. Download or email to the customer

Order Notes

Add notes to orders for internal reference:

  • Customer-facing notes: Visible to customers
  • Internal notes: Only visible to store admins

Searching and Filtering

Find orders quickly using:

  • Search: By order number, customer name, or email
  • Filters: By status, date range, payment method
  • Sorting: By date, amount, status

Exporting Orders

Export orders for accounting or analysis:

  1. Apply any filters you want
  2. Click "Export"
  3. Choose format (CSV or Excel)
  4. Download the file

Next Steps
